# Woodcutting

1 method trains Woodcutting, from wiki/world/methods.ts. Every XP/hr is the floor: the tick-perfect rate, not a forecast ([README](README.md) says what each column means). XP/hr is game XP, the server's XP rate (x25) included; gp/hr is the products kept at item value (obj `cost`); Supplies/hr is how many of each supply an hour uses, and their gp value.

Min is the level the whole method needs, every skill of it at that level together; a level column has Woodcutting at that level and every other skill at it or at the method's own level of it, whichever is higher, with the best axe usable there, and `-` under the method's Woodcutting level. gp/hr, the binding term and Supplies/hr are at 99.
